# blender-troubleshooting

Purpose: Structured 4-phase root-cause analysis when Blender output looks wrong. Use when render, export, scene, or handoff doesn't match intent and you need disciplined debug, not guesses.

Run a structured 4-phase root-cause analysis when a Blender output (render, export, GLB, preview, or final response) does not match the confirmed intent. Surface the actual cause before proposing any fix. Inspired by the `/systematic-debugging` skill in Anthropic Superpowers, adapted for Blender / non-Blender-user domain.

Metadata: Category `runtime-and-execution` | Role `scene-and-runtime-failure-diagnostician` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- a render came out black, blown out, missing assets, or just "wrong"
- a GLB export is empty, mis-scaled, or fails validation
- the non-Blender-user response sounds wrong (jargon-heavy, contradicted by evidence)
- the runtime smoke test passed but the recipe failed
- intent was clear but result diverges in a specific, reproducible way
- Trigger phrases: "the render looks wrong", "the GLB doesn't open / looks empty / is wrong scale", "the output doesn't match what I asked for", "why did it produce X instead of Y?", "debug this Blender output"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- the user has not yet stated a clear expected outcome (run intent-to-3d-brief-writer first) → use `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skill-intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`; run intent-to-3d-brief-writer first)
- runtime has never been attempted (run official-runtime-readiness-checker first) → use `official-runtime-readiness-checker` (`references/skill-official-runtime-readiness-checker.md`; run official-runtime-readiness-checker first)
- the request is creative iteration ("can we make it more dramatic"), not debugging → use `blender-brainstorming` (`references/skill-blender-brainstorming.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blender-brainstorming)
- the user wants a one-shot fix without diagnostic discipline → use `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skill-intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to intent-to-3d-brief-writer)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `observed_symptom_or_error` (`string`): Observed render defect, broken GLB export, scale mismatch, or MCP execution failure
- Required input `active_workflow_context` (`object`): Current scene plan, runtime path, and recent actions preceding the failure
- Optional input `runtime_attempt_notes` (`string`): Optional error output or attempt timeline from runtime-attempt-report-writer
- Output contract: `root_cause_classification`, `minimal_remediation_plan`, `reverification_target_skill` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. collect the symptom statement, expected outcome, and observed outcome
2. run the 4 phases: reproduce → narrow → identify root cause → propose fix
3. gate every conclusion on observable evidence
4. hand off the fix proposal to the relevant planner / readiness / evidence skill

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: This skill does not install Blender, run Blender, mutate scenes, render, export, or claim artifacts. It guides diagnosis. Any actual re-run goes through the relevant runtime skill (`official-runtime-readiness-checker`, `render-export-evidence`).
- running Blender
- writing fix code
- guessing without evidence
- replacing the runtime evidence skill
